tokens.thesis: Same-day ticker with no website and no socials. The book looked like demand because almost every wallet was a net buyer; by evening the main DexScreener pool had ~$4 of LP and was down 99.96% on the day.
tokens.public: DexScreener lists no website and no socials. Web search only finds a dead token with the same name on another chain — not this contract. https://dexscreener.com/robinhood/0xb4d0eb61e1602593e5aa230a3a0eedbdb9ac4b02
tokens.opponent: Bundled inventory selling into first-day retail.

tokens.thesis: Farm-pack sibling of HOOPLA. Public search has no credible Robinhood-chain story for this contract. 99.85% of wallets are net buyers and nobody who bought yesterday is still adding.
tokens.public: No DexScreener site/socials hit and no news item for 0xb0d55784… on RH. CoinGecko RH-meme list does not feature it.
tokens.opponent: Farm wallets walking a ticker into late bids.

tokens.thesis: CoinGecko will happily list DogBull with a market cap. The tape is still wash: mid buys and mid sells print the same dollars and almost nobody trades twice.
tokens.public: CoinGecko Robinhood Chain meme category lists DogBull — a listing is not a ladder.
tokens.opponent: Circular mid flow, not a crowd.

tokens.thesis: This is the chain's cat — the book, not a flip. The Aug 6 listing was a day not to chase. It is not a reason to sell. Tape is still organic. I hold it and I do not hop to the next ticker.
tokens.public: Robinhood listed CASHCAT in the app on Aug 6. That spike is priced. The name is still the flagship. https://coinsprobe.com/robinhood-lists-cashcat-memecoin-jumps-sharply-on-official-announcement/
tokens.opponent: Tourists sell the retrace. That is noise on a hold, not a thesis change.
tokens.kill: I only sell if this starts printing like a farm or the pool dies.
expected_absent: I'm out if another heavy net-sell

tokens.thesis: Not a naked ticker. Clutch Markets shipped 4,444 broker NFTs that hold stock tokens; the token is the activation chip. Two-way flow plus a few million of liquidity. The macro score is not there yet, so this is a read, not a chase.
tokens.public: https://www.stonkbrokers.cash · DexScreener lists the site and @ClutchMarkets. MC ~$52M, 24h +31%.
tokens.opponent: NFT/activation demand vs ordinary DEX sellers — not a 99% net-buy farm.
tokens.kill: liquidity collapses or the book starts looking like a farm.

tokens.thesis: The DEX tape can look like a reload while the float is not. DexScreener LP is thin versus a ~$35M MC, the book is −46% on the day, and Bubblemaps (Aug 13) flagged ~74% of supply in a tight cluster plus TikTok clips. Several other coins use the XST ticker.
tokens.public: Site https://xsolut.ai · warning https://www.cryptopolitan.com/bubblemaps-xst-warning-on-tiktok/ · DexScreener LP ~$93k vs $35M MC.
tokens.opponent: A clustered holder set can sell into organic-looking mid flow.
tokens.kill: I wouldn't add while the clustered-supply warning is still the public story.

tokens.thesis: A Uniswap designer minted the pools.trade teaser frog on July 30. Uniswap launched the launchpad on Aug 5 and disclaimed the token. That is a real coordination object, and the tape was a ladder — not 99% net-buy wallets.
tokens.opponent: Hot wallets rotating winners; retail not yet the only bid.
tokens.kill: Latest hour flips red or climax hour with negative net.
